title: Advancements in Recommender Systems: A Comprehensive Analysis Based on Data, Algorithms, and Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review and thematic coding classifying 10 out of 286 collected papers as addressing excessive preference or discrimination towards certain users/items (such as gender discrimination) in recommender system algorithms.

bias_targets.target: Data bias (System bias, Misleading bias, Feedback bias)
bias_targets.methodology: Systematic literature review categorizing recommender system data issues into system design limits, attribute misrepresentation, and imbalanced user feedback (e.g., long tail, herd, and exposure effects).
